categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Chuangyitong Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, research, production, and sales of precision connectors, connection cables, and precision structural parts. Its product lines include data storage interconnect products, consumer electronics interconnect products, communication interconnect products, and new energy precision connectors and structural components. The company focuses on high-speed interconnect products and has expanded into communications connectors and new energy precision structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced R&D capabilities, precision manufacturing processes including precision stamping, injection molding, and mold development with tolerances as tight as 0.002mm. It employs computer-aided simulation technologies (CAE) for structural, electrical, and thermal analysis to optimize product design and manufacturing. Automation and intelligent manufacturing technologies such as automated optical inspection, MES production management, and robotics are integrated to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international companies such as Shengdie Semiconductor, Molex, Xiaomi, Romoss, Anker Innovations, and Starckipon. The company serves industries including data storage, consumer electronics, 5G communications, and new energy vehicles. Its products are used in applications like solid-state drives, mobile devices, communication base stations, and electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for approximately 88% of revenue, and international sales making up about 12%. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Hubei, Guangxi, Hong Kong, and Malaysia, supporting both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Chuangyitong is positioned as a midstream manufacturer and supplier in the electronic components supply chain, specializing in the design and production of precision connectors and interconnect components that are critical for downstream electronic device manufacturers in data storage, consumer electronics, communications, and new energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and management innovation, focusing on developing high-speed, multifunctional, and miniaturized connectors. R&D efforts target new product development in Fakra RF connectors, medical hearing aid cables, automotive Type-C high-speed cables, CAN FD waterproof connectors, and high-current power connectors. It aims to enhance automation, scale production, and expand into new markets such as 5G communications and new energy vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including precision connectors, cables, and structural components. The company operates on an order-driven production model, fulfilling customer orders directly without intermediaries. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic early entrants and international leaders like TE Connectivity, Amphenol, and Molex, who have established production bases in China. Shenzhen Chuangyitong holds a competitive position particularly in high-speed interconnect products and data storage applications, leveraging strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities to maintain market share and customer trust.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 689 million, a 27.31% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 19.68 million, up 74.04%. Total assets were about RMB 1.36 billion with equity of RMB 641 million. The company has shown steady growth driven by market recovery in consumer electronics and data storage, and capacity expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its high-precision manufacturing, rapid product development cycles, and strong customization capabilities tailored to customer needs. It offers high-performance, reliable connectors with advanced features such as high-speed data transmission, environmental resistance, and miniaturization. Its integration of R&D and manufacturing, along with strategic partnerships with leading customers, provides a differentiated value proposition focused on quality, innovation, and service.
